title: Gliss
author: Daniel Musiklexikon
changes: C major glissando on a concert harp. Trimmed to 0.98–3.92 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The default 70 Hz high-pass also removes a constant DC offset in the original file.
